claim: On host nativestack-5975wx-20260925 on 2026-09-25, markitdown 0.1.8 was qualified against the installed 0.1.7 and then switched into production. The PyPI wheel (sha256 de7375a50578a39bcbbf13b48c67d99033d988e0ae8ad25af46ed432dbe4cbab, 89,737 bytes) and sdist (sha256 17188ad827ea79fc264c7b1ca8cf5a242a16278d84cc32f2edc475dbe92812ed, 69,112 bytes) matched PyPI's JSON and Simple API digests before `uv tool install --python 3.13` put the base package into a new tools/markitdown-0.1.8 prefix (20 packages; 45 of 45 package files byte-identical to the verified wheel). The candidate passed all 10 legs of run_arm.py: `--version` 'markitdown 0.1.8', greeting.md, 8k.md and 8-K stdout hashes (the stdout equal to the retained a27f0f27...), the discriminator hashes, check_outputs.py 12 PASS, the PDF refusal naming markitdown[pdf], the 20-package set with no extras and the consumer document. 0.1.7 failed exactly the version leg, the four 0.1.8 discriminator checks (8 PASS / 4 FAIL) and the markitdown line of the package set; the fixture, 8-K and consumer outputs and all 19 committed HTML files at ae30f94b converted byte-identically under both, and the 19 other distributions were byte-identical. An independent verifier reproduced these and agreed. The coordinator then repointed bin/markitdown to the new prefix; `markitdown --version` printed 'markitdown 0.1.8' and run_arm.py against the production path passed 10 of 10 legs.
limitations: Production runs the qualification prefix (a prefix flip), not install_pin's python-tools layout: its uv-receipt carries [tool.options] exclude-newer = "2026-09-25T17:00:00Z" and link-mode = "copy" and records python "3.13", which freezes `uv tool upgrade` inside that prefix. The refuter's primary promotion gate (install_pin's form without --exclude-newer, then production pip-list equality and an exclude-newer-free receipt) was not run. A new host's bootstrap runs `uv tool install --python 3.13 markitdown==0.1.8` without --exclude-newer, so its transitive set can differ from the qualified 20-package set once newer compatible dependency releases appear.

The 0.1.7 env python-tools/markitdown stays installed for rollback (re-point bin/markitdown), and its bookkeeping still reports 0.1.7. How a later install_pin run interacts with the flipped symlink was not tested.

0.1.8 changes output for <u> (kept as inline HTML), <strike> (~~text~~), %2F path escapes (preserved) and data-src images (preferred over a data: placeholder). These were shown only on the synthetic discriminator; the committed corpus has none of them in affected positions, real filings containing them were not tested, and a consumer that requires Markdown without raw HTML tags would now see <u>.

Local integration evidence (the reviewer-authored checker plus the refuter's legs), not the unchanged upstream suite: `hatch test` was not run on this host; the upstream CI pass on PR #2545 is research-reported. The [pdf]/[docx] extras were not exercised.

Integrity rests on PyPI's published digests and post-install byte equality with the verified wheel. The sha256 recorded in adoption/pins-linux-x86_64.json is not passed to uv (install_pin runs `uv tool install --python 3.13 markitdown==<version>`); whether uv verifies an index-provided digest itself was not established here. PyPI publishes no PEP 740 attestation for 0.1.8.

The no-extras grep leg misses some extras (an [az-doc-intel] addition passed it in the verifier's mutation test); only the exact 20-package equality leg gates the package set. Importing onnxruntime 1.30.0 writes $TMPDIR/.ses and an empty mat-debug-<pid>.log on every call, in both versions; the qualification runs left such files in /tmp.

The landscape ledger does not move here: catalogs/landscape/foundation.json keeps the document-retrieval winner pin markitdown 0.1.7 from the sealed 2026-09-22 layer-verdict packets. Host receipts recorded at 0.1.8 do not bind to that winner (scripts/host_receipts.py pin_matches) and stay unbound until a new verdict wave re-records the layer.
Linux x86_64 only: adoption/pins-macos-arm64.json has no markitdown pin and is unchanged; nothing here is macOS evidence.

One host (NativeStack, WSL2). The first post-switch run aborted before any leg because its run directory already existed; the retained 10-of-10 result is the rerun into a new directory. This receipt, not the 2026-09-23 qualification in evidence/artifacts/sota-refresh-20260923/pins-mem/markitdown.json (another host, another install kind, a non-discriminating check), is the basis for the 0.1.8 pin.

2026-09-26 retention correction (Codex post-merge review of #291): the claim's 45-of-45 installed-byte figure first rested on a summary line. verify_installed.py, the run directories behind run_arm.py's checker counts (converted documents, PDF stderr with the home directory replaced by ~, package listings) and the independent verifier's integrity and checker outputs are now retained. The 2026-09-25 stdout of verify_installed.py and run_arm.py's raw checker stdout were never written to files. out/verify-installed-rerun-20260926.out, out/installed-files-20260926.json and out/checker-rerun-20260926.out are 2026-09-26 read-only re-runs on the production prefix and the retained directories (results.json corrections and not_retained).
